messages:
maya_patel: Heads-up — I found a potential SSRF in the avatar image proxy. Logs show requests to 169.254.169.254 coming through the proxy query param (example: `GET /proxy?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/`).

dmitri: Can you paste the raw log line and the request headers?

maya_patel: ```
[2024-06-20T14:02:11Z] 10.4.5.22 GET /proxy?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ 200 "Mozilla/5.0" x-forwarded-for: 3.8.7.9
```

alex_cheung: If that's real we should flip the avatar proxy feature flag off immediately. ops_oncall, can you toggle `feature_flag:avatar_proxy`?

ops_oncall: On it — switching flag off now. Will report back when traffic drops.

sec_bot: [SECURITY ALERT] Created ticket SEC-2024-SSRF-27 and notified SRE + Legal.

caroline: Any indication of data exfil or customer impact yet? We need to know whether tokens or metadata were returned.

maya_patel: PoC reproduced locally. Example curl: `curl -v \"https://app.redwood.ai/proxy?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/\"` returns 200 with metadata paths (I redacted actual token strings).

dmitri: Reproduced in staging. Root cause: proxy accepts arbitrary `http://` targets and doesn't validate host/IP. Fix plan: 1) kill default http support, only allow whitelisted hostnames or https, 2) block private IP ranges (169.254.*, 10.*, 127.*, 172.16-31.*, 192.168.*) at app layer, 3) add strict input parsing. I'll open a PR to implement.

alex_cheung: Also add audit logging for proxy requests and a redaction policy for returned bodies. If any tokens are suspected exposed, rotate.

maya_patel: Also noticed a separate authz weakness in admin export: if `X-Internal: true` header present, the role check is bypassed. Filed SEC-2024-AUTHZ-09 as follow-up. Might be independent but worth simultaneous review.

ops_oncall: Feature flag off applied at 1718901540. Verified via metrics: avatar-proxy traffic to private IPs dropped to zero. Blocking external rollout until patch merges.

dmitri: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/987 — includes host allowlist, IP blocklist, header sanitization, and unit tests. Added integration test that queries `http://169.254.169.254` and asserts 403.

caroline: Good. Action items: 1) Draft postmortem (24h timeline) 2) Prepare customer comms template if tokens were exposed 3) Rotate any keys if confirmed 4) Add e2e regression to CI 5) Schedule security review for admin header logic.

maya_patel: I'll own PoC timeline and the comms draft. Adding incident to #incidents for cross-team visibility.

ops_oncall: Marking incident as contained for now. Will close SEC-2024-SSRF-27 after PR merges to prod and we validate no requests to metadata in the last 24h. :white_check_mark:

dmitri: Merged to staging, requesting sec review @maya_patel. Will promote to prod after one hour of clean smoke tests.

caroline: Nice work — please include a list of logs to retain (redacted) and the KMS/secret rotation checklist in the postmortem.

maya_patel: Noted. I'll attach logs, PoC, and timeline to the SEC ticket.

sec_bot: Reminder: schedule a 1-hour postmortem meeting within 48 hours.

ops_oncall: Closing loop here, leaving action items in the ticket. If anyone sees related anomalies ping in thread.
